CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  WELCOMES YOU TO A SPECIAL
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  July 21, 2026

NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING

The City of Signal Hill appreciates your attendance. Public interest provides the Council and
Agency with valuable information regarding issues of the community. Regular meetings are
held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of every month.

This agenda was posted 24 hours prior to the meeting on the City’s website and outside of
City Hall. The agenda and related reports are also available for review online at
www.cityofsignalhill.org.

Zoom Two-Way Audio For Online Meeting Participation

  • In addition to viewing City Council meetings through the City's live and on-demand
  streaming service, members of the public may provide live public comments during City
  Council meetings via Zoom Webinar.

  • How to Connect to the Zoom Webinar Two-Way Audio Conference by Telephone
  Participants joining by telephone will be identified by the last four digits of their
  telephone number. If you wish to provide public comment, please use the “Raise Hand”
  feature during the applicable public comment period by pressing *9. When called upon,
  kindly state your name for the record.

  To Join the meeting dial: +1 (669) 900-6833

  Meeting ID: 933 6345 0327
